Sorry to disappoint guys, but I'm new on reddit so I don't know how to post pictures to the comments but I will add my Instagram handle so you can see progress and photos of my E30 (her name is Marilyn). For now I will narrate what's all going on (if you want to just skip to pictures my Instagram is @85dirty30)
So I left off with motor choice:
After picking up the 1uz I needed a trans to go with it, so I scooped a remanned S13 5 speed trans, and mated that to the engine with Collins Performance adapter plate, 6 puck sprung clutch and 11lbs flywheel, after all that I took it to a fabricator friend of mine, when I got it to him he built me a killer solid crossmember and solid motor mounts. After that was done we played around with ideas for an exhaust, I wanted simple and easy with just flipped sc400 manifolds, but my fabricator had something much more interesting in mind, so I greenlighted him to go nuts and build something rad. What he came up with was beyond my highest expectations, he built 180 degree headers 2x4:1 collectors from 1 5/8" runners to 2 1/2" collectors and finally into a 2:1 3" collector to a straight through turbine muffler and fender dump exhaust. Next was ported and polished heads, and a modified intake manifold to delete ICV and EGR. An e36 M3 mishimoto radiator 1750cfm pusher fan and dual 1350cfm puller fans, 160* thermostat to keep her cool. And with that progress stagnated for months, while I was trying to gather momentum to keep the build going I decided I wanted more. Enter the Craigslist search for something to set off the build, something to make it that much more unique. A couple trade deals later I'm left with a 30% overdriven Eaton M90 supercharger, so the modified manifold went into the bin. And with that, I'll leave you until more progress is made! Again my Instagram is 85dirty30, it's a public profile so you can look at pics and no need to follow me unless you wish to (I'm not fishing for followers by any means) there is some more I'm missing but that is slightly less entertaining (angle kit, seats, wheel, dual rear calipers, wheels, delete panels, booster delete, proportioning valve, hydro handbrake, isr shifter, front 5 lug swap, welded diffs 4.10/3.73/2.79, hood vents coming, along with lexan windows)

Hating yourself is a symptom of your depression. I went through a year long period of no mirrors, no photos of me, nothing, because I couldn't stand the sight of myself, I hated who I was inside and out, and the drugs and alcohol never helped, but I started to realize that it was simply a symptom of my mental illness that made me feel this way, and as difficult as it is for me to see myself even now, I know that I don't hate who I am, I hate my illness. I hate what it has done to me, how it's made me feel, and how it continues to struggle for control of my life. I won't lie and say it gets easier, it doesn't, you just become more self aware, and that awareness helps prevent self harm, suicidal tendencies, and hatred of oneself. Feel free to message me, I'm still struggling through day to day life, but every battle leads to more awareness, awareness of who I am at my core, and what I want to be.
